up: Find all distinct compounds tested against the target CHEMBL2146302 in assays where the assay organism is Homo sapiens. Return chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Join activities with assays and target_dictionary, filtering by target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2146302' and assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles, and join molecule_dictionary on molregno to retrieve chembl_id. Use SELECT DISTINCT to ensure each compound is listed only once.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2146302' AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens';
